projections.events: Durable append-only log of produced or received evidence envelopes, keyed by event_id.
projections.admitted: Subset of events that passed validation AND has all causal prerequisites satisfied. Only admitted events may feed current_view.
projections.current_view: Map of scoped keys to the currently applicable record, derived only from admitted events under lifecycle rules.
projections.receipts: One row per (event_id, from_store, to_store) exposing delivery_state, counters, uncertainty and the admission it references.
projections.history_view: Per-event lifecycle chain: original bytes/digest/revision plus superseded, corrected and quarantined status.
projections.quarantine: Received-but-refused envelopes with an explicit reason; never merged into events.
projections.acceptance: Independent axes of task/work state that no delivery mechanism may move.

receipt_counter_schema.attempts_total: every inbound transport attempt carrying this event_id
receipt_counter_schema.admissions: count of distinct admissions; MUST be 0 or 1 for a given event_id
receipt_counter_schema.duplicate_suppressed: attempts whose event_id AND payload_digest matched an already-received envelope
receipt_counter_schema.conflict_rejected: attempts whose event_id matched but payload_digest differed
receipt_counter_schema.uncertain: true while the producer has sent but has no receipt
receipt_counter_schema.uncertain_windows: retained list of [opened_at, closed_at] intervals; reconciliation MUST NOT erase them

tenant.note: Single tenant on purpose; cross-scope disclosure is C25's job, not C10's.

agent_principals.note: Service principal. Distinct identity from usr-blake per R01.

hosts.note: Deliberate skew. Outcome must be skew-independent.

stores.note: Label is mutable; store identity is not.

seed_events.statement: Pricing totals are rounded once, at the order line, under the documented policy.

planned_events.statement: At c102, svc/pricing/round.ts rounds twice for multi-line orders.
Correction of evt-1002-infer: rounding mode is HALF_EVEN.
At c103, the double-rounding path is gone; one rounding call remains.

adversarial_envelopes.statement: At c102, svc/pricing/round.ts rounds once. (Same id, different bytes.)

adversarial_envelopes.note: A new identity carrying the semantics of an ack-uncertain event. Its existence anywhere is a C10 failure.

trigger_sequence.action: Seed evt-0001-ruling admitted on both stores with a complete receipt; set host-south clock +90s.
Transfer E1 to store-north. store-north validates and admits it, emits receipt rcpt-A. The return path drops rcpt-A.
trigger_sequence.expected_state: store-north admitted E1; store-south receipts[E1] = sent_unacked, uncertain=true, attempts_total=1

trigger_sequence.action: Retry E1 byte-identical (same event_id, same payload_digest). store-north dedups and re-emits the receipt referencing the SAME admission. Receipt arrives.
trigger_sequence.expected_state: store-south receipts[E1] = admitted_acked, uncertain=false, attempts_total=2; store-north admissions=1, duplicate_suppressed=1

trigger_sequence.action: Record E2 then E3 (E3 corrects E2) into store-south.
Deliver E3 to store-north BEFORE E2.
trigger_sequence.expected_state: store-north events contains E3; admitted does NOT; receipts[E3] = received_pending_causal with pending_on=[evt-1002-infer]

trigger_sequence.action: Deliver E2 to store-north. E2 admits; E3's prerequisite is satisfied and E3 admits from the pending set.
Hard-kill the store-north process and cold-start it from durable evidence only.
Consumer cursor rewind: replay the batch [E3, E1, E2, E1, E3] into store-north.

trigger_sequence.actor: harness (injected transport frame; NOT store-south's outbox)
trigger_sequence.action: Deliver E1-CONFLICT (event_id evt-1001-obs, payload_digest sha256:d1x) into store-north.
trigger_sequence.note: store-south must never be recorded as the producer of these bytes; its outbound attempt count stays 4.

trigger_sequence.action: POSITIVE CONTROL: record E4 into store-north; deliver once to store-south; then deliver one byte-identical retry.
Probe every acceptance axis on both stores for wd-pricing-rounding at c103.
Delete store-north's materialized/derived index and rebuild it from the durable event log.
Re-run T1..T12 for each delivery permutation in permutation_matrix and each clock-skew sign, on fresh stores.

receipts.note: 4 outbound sends vs 5 inbound attempts at store-north; the difference is exactly the injected conflict frame, which store-south must not be credited with producing.

negative_assertions.assertion: No event_id other than evt-1001-obs ever carries payload_digest sha256:d1 in either store, in any outbox, or in any transport log, at any step.
negative_assertions.requirement: C10 'no new operation silently replacing an uncertain one'

negative_assertions.assertion: Between T5 and T6, evt-1003-corr never appears in store-north.admitted nor contributes to current_view, and evt-1002-infer is never synthesized, guessed or back-filled by the consumer.
E1-CONFLICT never overwrites, merges into, or silently replaces evt-1001-obs; store-north.events['evt-1001-obs'].payload_digest is sha256:d1 before and after T9.
negative_assertions.requirement: R07 reused identity with conflicting bytes

negative_assertions.assertion: Between T2 and T3 no store reports evt-1001-obs as delivered or acknowledged; the sent_unacked/uncertain state is queryable throughout that window.
No receipt, admission, dedup or reconciliation moves any acceptance axis; acceptance_transitions_caused_by_T1_through_T12 == 0.
negative_assertions.requirement: R04; 01-foundation 'Exchange acknowledgements do not become task acceptance'

negative_assertions.assertion: No event that reached state admitted is ever absent afterwards, including across the T7 restart, the T8 replay and the T12 index loss.
negative_assertions.requirement: R07 no silently lost acknowledged event

negative_assertions.assertion: evt-1003-corr (class model_inference) never supersedes, weakens or restates evt-0001-ruling, and never writes a key outside scope svc/pricing/.
negative_assertions.requirement: R05, R06; 01-foundation 'A lower-authority inference cannot supersede the ruling'

negative_assertions.assertion: No projection or report claims exactly-once network delivery; every receipt exposes attempts_total and uncertain.

positive_controls.description: evt-2001-obs, a legitimate in-scope write by usr-avery on store-north, traverses local_durable -> queued -> received -> admitted -> materialized -> context_included on store-south with exactly one admission and a complete receipt, and appears in current_view on both stores.
The byte-identical retry of evt-2001-obs returns SUCCESS referencing the existing admission, not an error and not a second event. Dedup must not degrade into refusal.

Out-of-scope control: an event written to svc/shipping/ by usr-avery is admitted normally and is absent from every svc/pricing/ current_view query, proving scope filtering is real and not a blanket block.

permutation_matrix.invariance_claim: events, admitted, current_view, quarantine and acceptance_probe must be identical across all 12 combinations. receipts may differ only in observed_at and in the ordering of attempt records, never in attempts_total, admissions, duplicate_suppressed or conflict_rejected.

pass_fail_rule.pass: All A-assertions in the oracle document, all negative assertions N1-N8, and all positive controls P1-P3 hold for all 12 permutation/skew combinations.
pass_fail_rule.note: Per the go/no-go criteria, an authority-changing error or silent loss of an acknowledged event is immediate rejection regardless of every other measurement.
